Skills for installing and exposing skillhook, authoring webhook skills and operating Skillhook Cloud, plus two MCP servers: skillhook (status, skills, secrets, jobs, Tailscale exposure, signed test webhooks) and skillhook-cloud (every machine of the organisation, as the dashboard shows and runs it).
